card.name: The 9 in 1900s years
card.fires_on: The digit 9 right after a leading 1 when a twentieth-century year is being written, such as 1953 or 1999, in history or nature text. It also fires once on the word whether after a comma.

modes.label: Year digit 9
modes.description: The 9 in the second place of a year in the 1900s, after the digit 1.
modes.example: It was first climbed on 20 May 1<<9>>53, by J.O.M.

modes.label: Stray linking word
modes.description: The word whether after a comma, in a travel offer.
modes.example: coming to Egypt for a visit,<< whether>> alone or in a group
